Ani sanda ufa minnisee ueeqee mariasa qinee niqafamasee fidiaqaamma nimaqaidaqa.
Sia ani naamuaqira ufa mau fimarianara miqidaqa.
Oo Yaawee doo qafaa, ani naakapara ufara firaaqoo dididanoo.
Ani aidirafa sia moosaa fimarinara mariqoo kai marinara qini marirana afeedamma qisaa.
Ani sanda ufa oosana anoona maridanoo.
Marifanoo ani aiqama andeeqara rainannimaqara ufafa naaru naaru marirafa maridanoo.
Misa faiqí uriqararausa misa fifau qini mandaikamma qimaqaidaqa.
Misa miqi mariafaqa qinee ani sanda ufara kai qeerairammasee qaindusidaqa.
Qinee ani qima afeekaikira ufara firaaqoo asasidaqa.
Mee faiqí moo fannoo koorara paqurimmasee asasindee qinee faqa miqi kai masee ani ufara asasidaqa.
Qinee aiqama unna ufara qikooqeenoo fidiaqaa uqanna qidaqa.
Miqi marunanoo ani sanda ufara kai dididanoo.
Qinee aiqama faasaana moodaanai qisauku taikasee dinni oonu qaaraqanda marasee kari ani andeeqara rainannimaqaranara dufi dufi qimamaqaidaqa.
Ani sandufara nidi marisa asooaranaki maridaqa.
Sia moo ainaina fannoo nikuama niminaqa saamurifaranoo.
Oo Yaawee anee qini asumu mara qisaanneera afeesidaqa anee daamuaqianna mau kai fidaqa.
Qinee ani naakapara ufa mau fidaqa.
Qinee qeeqa aiqama qimuqusannoo minara dididanoo.
Qinee ani naamuaqira ufa faqa ani naakapara ufa mau fidaqa.
Qinee aiqama ainaina auqee marunnana anee qafee mariananoo.
Oo Yaawee qini nammeera qirafa anee iannannai oorufuani.
Aneenna qima afeekaikunandee inana irirana oosana qimia.
Qini innaaruqirana irisee aneenna qima afeekaikammaqoonnana amana kai mara amiqira qoo quqaqisaa.
Anee aneenna sanda ufa qima qimiannanara qinee aiqama kari ani amooqianaura.
Ani naamuaqira ufa aiqamausa andeeqasee raina nimaqee marifa marinara ani sanda ufara idi raanaura.
Qinee ani naamuaqira ufa afaqee marunnanara aiqama kari qini dadaaqirara deedaqina maria.
Oo Yaawee qinee ummaaraki marunnanara firaaqoo ani afeedamma qimaqaranara rakisidaqa.
Qinee asasirana ani sandufaki paquridaqa.
Anee maqee marirana qiminaqa amana qinee ani amooqianaura.

Qinee auiara sipsipara foora auiaqa nidaqa.
